foreground_contract.timing: Original foreground enters from lower right F000→F008; unchanged after F008. No new foreground keyframes.

production_base.reason: Use independently reviewed semantic neck/collar focus with same geometry as original focus; avoids relocking old purple/white collar. Original focus is geometric provenance only.
production_base.new_neck_masks: Do not reuse old static neck mask for rotated head; redraw and remeasure actual new neck/collar boundary.

frozen_exposure_contract: Opus da4035d 14:00: 9 exposure states, total 36f. Midturn 15deg, full turn30deg. Full turn has5deg image-left roll, chin slightly lifted, eyes looking back to the same offscreen phone. F021/023 exact same head/face/eyes/ears/neck/roots; free tails only.

revision2_projection_notes.fixed_collar: Semantic inner edge, not horizontal crop
revision2_projection_notes.ear_exposure: Near104 maximum/far21 residual. No ear scaling.
revision2_projection_notes.tail_motion: Far tail follows skull with delayed free-end swing. Near free-tail swing is independently18px equilibrium displacement so yaw/roll cancellation of root x does not kill inertial action.
revision2_projection_notes.phone_gaze: Screen-right/down relative to turned face. Phone location not redrawn. Iris offsets are pose direction guidance rather than literal eye ray reconstruction.
